scripts.text: In the opposite case, I will kill you too, you understand? So don't ever stray, and do not ever forget your determination.
scripts.translation: 反之亦然，我也会杀了你，你明白吗？所以永远不要偏离正道，也永远不要忘记你的决心。

scripts.text: Brother, you think about hell. It will never happen, so... Don't talk that way.
scripts.translation: 哥哥，你想得也太可怕了。那种事永远不会发生的，所以...别那样说。

scripts.text: I have been acting for Brother and Kingdom, and I will be the same ever after.
scripts.translation: 一直为了哥哥和王国在行动，以后也会一样。

scripts.text: How could you appear so suddenly? Ern and I were in the middle of conversation.
scripts.translation: 。你怎么突然出现？我和恩斯特正在谈话。

scripts.text: What's wrong, brother? We were not talking about anything bad. We were just making our resolution firm.
scripts.translation: 怎么了，哥哥？我们没在说坏事。我们只是在坚定我们的决心。

scripts.text: You came here in good timing. We've just decided to kill the other... if one of us is corrupt.
scripts.translation: 你来得正好。我们刚刚约定，要是有一人变得腐败，就由另一人杀了他。

scripts.text: By all means, be the witness of this agreement. You cannot say no. Because it is a very good thing, in some respects, for your work, isn't it?
scripts.translation: 无论如何，请见证这个约定。你不能拒绝。因为从某些方面来说，这对你的工作很有利，不是吗？

scripts.text: Br...Brother. You are way too suppressive. Our appraiser must have his own position and opinion.
scripts.translation: 哥...哥哥。你太霸道了。我们的评估员必须有自己的立场和意见。

scripts.text: You still have a weak personality. I am not forcing something so difficult on him! Who cares? I take silence as a positive answer! My bid is successful! And our promise is formed too!
scripts.translation: 你这性子，还是太软弱了。我又没强迫他做什么难事！管他呢，沉默就当答应了！提议通过，咱们的约定也就成立了！

scripts.text: Haah...haha... Appraiser, I deeply apologize for offending you. Sorry, but there is no possibility of fulfilling this promise. So, just don't take this situation seriously... You know... When pigs fly... ~
scripts.translation: Haah...haha... 评估员，冒犯了你，实在抱歉。不过，这种约定根本不可能有兑现的一天，所以别太当真...你也知道，除非太阳打西边出来...~

scripts.text: Now, let me return to my room. Keep up the good work, appraiser.
scripts.translation: 现在，让我回房间了。继续努力吧，评估员。

scripts.text: from my family is coming today. But I haven't found him yet.
scripts.translation: 会有人来，可我到现在还没见到。

scripts.text: What do you want to say this time?...
I am in real penance right now!
I know you are a faithful person, engaged in a very important issue for the kingdom, but you come here more than is necessary...
scripts.translation: 了。我知道你尽职尽责，在替王国办大事，但也用不着来这么多趟吧...

scripts.text: Is that so? Then, see you later.
I saw a person from the Walter family.
scripts.translation: 我见到了沃尔特家族的人。

scripts.text: why didn't he come to me?

scripts.translation: -我向阿鲁姆讲述了事情经过。-

scripts.text: What! Are you 100% sure about your story? Ahhhh...
scripts.translation: 什么！你确定你讲的是事实吗？啊...

scripts.text: I am very sorry, but I want to be left alone. Leave me alone, right now!
scripts.translation: 非常抱歉，我想一个人静静。现在立刻离开！

scripts.text: I am very sorry, but I want to be left alone. Leave me alone, right now!
scripts.translation: 非常抱歉，我想一个人静静。现在立刻离开！

scripts.text: I told you that I don't want to be king, and I don't have any intention to change my mind!
scripts.translation: 我说过我不想当国王，而且我绝不改变主意！

scripts.text: Brother! I don't know why you are suffering so much! Are you this weak a creature?!
scripts.translation: 哥哥！我不知道你为什么这么痛苦！难道你就这么软弱吗？！

scripts.text: Suffering? Me?..Aaahhh... It looks so...? Yeahh... Yes, it does. Stressful...Huhuhu...Hahaha!!
scripts.translation: 痛苦？我？...Aaahhh... 看起来像吗...？是啊...的确如此。真难受啊...Huhuhu...Hahaha!!

scripts.text: ...Is it only me that gets away... Anyhow, I am a disqualified person ... huhuhu. But, I've made a decision.
scripts.translation: ...难道就我一个人在逃避吗...反正我已经不配了...huhuhu.不过，我已经做出了决定。

scripts.text: - Ahrum casually throws a Bazerald to Ernst.-
scripts.translation: - 阿鲁姆随手将一把华丽短剑扔给了恩斯特。-

scripts.text: Eh?... What's this about?... A Bazerald of Walter family?...Why?
scripts.translation: 呃？...这是怎么回事？...沃尔特家族的华丽短剑？...为什么？

scripts.text: Now this is perfect timing. Even our witness is here! Ern, you remember our promise clearly, right?
scripts.translation: 时机真是完美。连我们的证人都在场！恩斯特，你很清楚我们之间的约定，对吧？
什么？约定？证人？...啊...真...真的是...

scripts.text: Yes, really. Now is the time.
Nonsense! Do you think I can do that to you?!
scripts.translation: 胡说！你以为我会对你下杀手吗？！

scripts.text: Idiot! Being King should be followed by decisive action. I have no chances to be King. Corruption, and living like that, is worse than being killed by you...
scripts.translation: 蠢货！当国王就得杀伐果断。我已经没资格当国王了。与其腐败下去，这样苟活，倒不如死在你手里...

scripts.text: B-but, you can live as you are! As if nothing happened. You are just needed to return to the way you were before. Brother, let me help you. Tell me everything you hide...
scripts.translation: 不...不，你可以像以前一样活下去！就当什么都没发生过。你只需要回到从前的样子。哥哥，让我帮帮你。告诉我你隐藏的一切...

scripts.text: This is so moronic! Can you say that you are kingly?! Are you showing me sympathy now? You should be a man of sense! If not, you are not eligible as a king candidate!
scripts.translation: 这太愚蠢了！你还能说自己有王者风范吗？现在才来同情我？你应该是个有理智的人！如果不是，你就没有资格成为国王候选人！

scripts.text: Talking back and forth is of no use! I cannot help it. If you keep insisting instead of trying to be a man of sense, then such a person should not be a king.
scripts.translation: 这样来回争论毫无意义！我别无选择。如果你坚持己见，而不是像个有理智的人那样行事，那么这样的人就不配当国王。

scripts.text: you would kill me... You just wanted to be killed
scripts.translation: 你说过要杀我...你只是想让我杀你吗？..

scripts.text: Huhu... Not at all. I just wanted to kill you... That's it... Good job, Ern... This is legal self-defense, killing a villain... right?
scripts.translation: Huhu... 才不是。我就是想杀了你...仅此而已...干得好，恩斯特...杀死恶徒，算是合法自卫...对吧？

scripts.text: B..Brother... even now it is not too late! If you go to a medic, you can be restored!
scripts.translation: 哥...哥哥...现在还不晚！如果你去找医务兵，还能救回来！

scripts.text: It's too late... Once your vital organs are stabbed... I wonder how could I stay alive... or even how I could come back to life... I don't need to live.
scripts.translation: 太晚了...一旦要害被刺穿...我还能怎么活下来...或者怎么复活...我不需要活着。
哥...哥哥...你...你怎么能这样？！

scripts.text: Goodbye, my brother... Be King, and change this nation. You... You can make it...guk...
scripts.translation: 再见，我的兄弟...成为国王，改变这个国家。你...你一定能做到...guk...

scripts.text: ...Brother...Brother... Why... Why... How can your face look so satisfied? How...? Brother...
scripts.translation: ...哥哥...哥哥...为什么...为什么...你的表情看起来那么满足？怎么...？哥哥...

scripts.text: Huhu...You don't need to know that. By the way, you kept your promise... You should be king... But if you are lost, and stray, I will come kill you at any time... from hell!!
scripts.translation: Huhu...你不必知道。不过，你遵守了约定...你应该成为国王...可你若迷失方向、误入歧途，我随时会从地狱回来杀你！！

scripts.text: I...I don't know! I don't know what's going on!
scripts.translation: 我...我不知道！我不知道发生了什么！

scripts.text: You don't need to... What you have to know about is that there was a sacrifice from me. To make my death meaningful, you should be a good king. That's my conviction... That's it..guk..! Don't lose my words... gukkuk.
scripts.translation: 你不必知道...你只要记得，我为此做出了牺牲。为了不让我的死白费，你一定要做个好国王。这是我的信念...就是这样...guk..!别忘了我的话...gukkuk.

scripts.text: Ahh... Appraiser, do you know what you have to do? Be mindful of your words. About what you saw, what you heard... You must not tell all of your experience to the inspector.
scripts.translation: 啊...评估员，你知道该怎么做吗？谨言慎行。关于你看到的、听到的...你绝不能把你的经历全部告诉检查员。

scripts.text: Ern killed a villain here who bullied around.. I had no chance... He showed decisive action, and that will deserve him the right to be king...
scripts.translation: 恩斯特在这里杀死了那个横行霸道的恶棍...我没有机会...他展现了果断的行动，这足以让他拥有成为国王的资格...

scripts.text: If you react wrongfully to this incident, my death will be worthless...kuk... Do you understand?
scripts.translation: 要是你没处理好这件事，我就白死了...kuk...明白吗？

scripts.text: ... Okay I will follow your will...
... Okay, I will follow your will. Don't worry...
scripts.translation: ...好的，我会遵从你的意愿。别担心...

scripts.text: Ignorance... is positive... It means... My bid... is successful...
scripts.translation: 沉默...就是同意...这意味着...我的提议...成功了...

scripts.text: Now... I can die... with peace... Thank... you very... much, both... of you.
scripts.translation: 现在...我可以...安息了...谢...谢你们...两个...

scripts.text: Then, perpetually... Bye... Sorry ... now I can't go fishing.
scripts.translation: 那么，永远...再见...抱歉...现在没法去钓鱼了。

scripts.text: You are not allowed to be here.
I don't want to confront you.
Are you the new adventurer appraiser? I am Eigen Ahrum from the Walter family. You can call me Prince Ahrum, for short, at your convenience.
scripts.translation: 你是新的冒险者评估员吗？我是沃尔特家族的艾根·阿鲁姆。你可以叫我阿鲁姆王子，这样比较方便。

scripts.text: I hope you ask me short and simple questions. Long questions don't always mean special and good answers.
scripts.translation: 问题尽量简短明了吧。问得冗长，也不见得能得到什么独到、精彩的回答。

scripts.text: Never mind, I'll come by later.
You aren't just trying to dissolve your curiosity about the king's family, are you?
scripts.translation: 你该不会只是想满足对王室的好奇心吧？

scripts.text: From my childhood, I liked to experience many things and learn them. As a result, I should bear interference from my family. To them, I was not a decent noble family member.
scripts.translation: 从小我就喜欢体验各种事物并从中学习。结果就是，我不得不忍受家族的干涉。在他们眼里，我并不是一个得体的贵族。

scripts.text: But I am not sensitive to that, and I think a good king should neglect those trifles.
scripts.translation: 不过，我不在意。我觉得，想做个好国王，就不该把这些琐事放在心上。

scripts.text: Others can say that my behavior makes them embarrased, but if something ends well, they are all satisfied in the end. Am I wrong?
scripts.translation: 别人可能会说我的行为让他们感到尴尬，但如果事情最终圆满，他们终究会满意的。我这样想错了吗？

scripts.text: Although I've skipped some lessons in life, I can back up missing lessons easily. Who cares who can swear to me as King! This is how I am.
scripts.translation: 虽然人生有些课我没好好上过，但要补上也不难。谁管别人愿不愿意拥我为王！我就是这样的人。

scripts.text: about this, but I don't make an issue in any case. Such a fastidious jerk.
scripts.translation: 此唠叨我，但我无论如何都不会在意。真是个挑剔的家伙。

scripts.text: Like I said, I've been growing up with his scolds. I feel his words were harsher than others who shut their mouth after I accomplish something.
scripts.translation: 就像我说的，我从小就是在他的斥责中长大的。我觉得他的话比那些在我做成事后就闭嘴的人更严厉。

scripts.text: He always says that results cannot be everything that matter.
scripts.translation: 他总是说，结果不能代表一切。

scripts.text: Before everything else, it is luck and glory for me, that I could be born in Walter, a distinguished noble family.
scripts.translation: 首先，对我来说，最大的幸运和荣耀就是出生在沃尔特这个显赫的贵族家庭。

scripts.text: are underestimated because of my background. In other respects, I feel sad about it.
scripts.translation: 我的出身而低估我的能力。想到这一点，又觉得有些遗憾。

scripts.text: In the coming age, people will talk about me as Eigen Ahrum from the Walter family, not Eigen Ahrum of Walter.
scripts.translation: 将来，人们提起我时，会说“出身沃尔特的艾根·阿鲁姆”，而不是“沃尔特家的艾根·阿鲁姆”。

scripts.text: The Walter family itself has high distinction and fame, but I will make the name shine further, and others will be proud of me.
scripts.translation: 沃尔特家族本身享有崇高的地位和名声，但我会让这个名字更加闪耀，让其他人以我为荣。

scripts.text: For sure, losers and depressed people have their own faults, like lesser challenges for their lives.
scripts.translation: 失败者和失意的人，当然也有自己的问题，比如不愿主动挑战生活。

scripts.text: I have some belief in the benefit of unlimited competition. Frankly, I don't like this king election system from noble families.
scripts.translation: 我相信，充分竞争能带来好处。坦白说，我并不喜欢这种只从贵族家族中选国王的制度。

scripts.text: I will be the king, with my sole capability and aptitude! Hahaha.
scripts.translation: 也能凭自己的能力和才干当上国王！哈哈哈。

scripts.text: But I can't find one distinguished person who can lead this kingdom well.
scripts.translation: 到一个能很好地领导这个王国的杰出人物。

scripts.text: I'm not saying they aren't outstanding, but considering the current situation of Rune-Midgarts, they don't seem to be astonishing leaders.
scripts.translation: 我不是说他们不优秀，但考虑到卢恩·米德加兹的现状，他们似乎并不是令人惊叹的领袖。

scripts.text: For this reason, I assure you that no candidate is fit for the position among them. If I have to pick someone who can be a match for me, I can say that one is Ernst.
scripts.translation: 正因如此，我向你保证，他们之中没有一个人适合这个职位。如果非要选一个能与我匹敌的人，我会说是恩斯特。

scripts.text: He has a soft personality and thinks too long about things, but I admit many merits to him. I can say he is a fairly high-standard candidate.
scripts.translation: 他性子软，遇事考虑得太久，不过我承认，他有很多长处。可以说，他是个相当出色的候选人。

scripts.text: I apologize for my redundant words, hahaha.
quite fit for the scholar type people.
scripts.translation: 那倒适合学究气重的人。

scripts.text: My brother Ern can stick to something for a long time, like books or study.
scripts.translation: 我的兄弟恩斯特能长时间专注于某件事，比如读书或学习。

scripts.text: It's very hard for me to do that.
I don't want to see anyone.
Did you meet my brother Ahrum? He is a great man. Really.
scripts.translation: 你见过我阿鲁姆哥哥吗？他是个很棒的人。真的。

scripts.text: He tries to deal with things too tough that sometimes makes things into a problem. But even at those moments, he is willing to listen to my words; so we seldom seem to be in serious trouble.
scripts.translation: 他有时处事太强硬，反而会惹出问题。不过就算在那种时候，他也愿意听我的劝，所以我们很少真闹出大乱子。

scripts.text: That can only be that way, because we two have been so close to each other.
scripts.translation: 之所以能这样，是因为我们兄弟俩一直关系很亲密。

scripts.text: Brother Ahrum has been blaming me for that, I think unnecessarily too long. But he listens to me and acts as I advise.
scripts.translation: 我觉得阿鲁姆哥哥为此责备我有些没必要，而且责备得太久了。但他听我的话，并按照我的建议行事。
他不是一个伟大的人吗

scripts.text: He is a trustworthy and instructive person.
scripts.translation: ？他是一个值得信赖且能给人启发的人。

scripts.text: Ah, now I am going to have a plan with Bro Ahrum
scripts.translation: 啊，我和阿鲁姆哥哥还有约。

scripts.text: If you don't have a important issue with me, I shall go.
scripts.translation: 如果没有要紧事，我就先走了。

scripts.text: Ah, I heard person from Walter came in here. Have you seen him?
scripts.translation: 啊，我听说沃尔特的人来了这里。你见过他吗？

scripts.text: It seems that even brother Ahrum hasn't met with him. Hmm...
scripts.translation: 看来连阿鲁姆哥哥都还没见到他。嗯...

scripts.text: Why don't you slow down your work?
scripts.translation: 呢。要不要放慢些脚步，歇一歇？

scripts.text: Hmm...I don't have any more words to say. Moreover, Ahrum seems to be strange these days. I worry about that. I hope it's not a big deal.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我没什么话要说了。而且，阿鲁姆最近似乎有些不对劲。我很担心。希望不是什么大事。

scripts.text: It's not a normal change, but a real corruption. I feel uneasy about it.
scripts.translation: 。这不是普通的改变，而是真正的堕落。这让我感到不安。

scripts.text: I believe Ahrum will be restored as he was. However, I don't feel good.
scripts.translation: 我相信阿鲁姆会恢复原样。但我心里很不好受。

scripts.text: Please leave here. I don't want to see anyone.
scripts.translation: 请离开这里。我不想见任何人。

scripts.text: Thank you for your hard work. It's hard to judge others, isn't it?
scripts.translation: 感谢您的辛勤工作。评判他人是很困难的事，不是吗？

scripts.text: You are not a adventurer judge
I think you shouldn't be here.
scripts.translation: 我觉得你不应该在这里。

scripts.text: I am Ernst, prince of Geoborg.
scripts.translation: 我是恩斯特，吉尔伯格的王子。

scripts.text: I think it's hard work that judges people's talents. I will do my best to help you.
scripts.translation: 我认为评判他人的才能是一项艰巨的工作。我会尽力协助您。

scripts.text: (He seems to have a polite personality as a candidate for King)
scripts.translation: （作为国王候选人，他似乎是个彬彬有礼的人）

scripts.text: I want to know your spirit of nationalism.
scripts.translation: 我想了解你的治国理念

scripts.text: Since I was young, I have grown up with a royal education. I haven't quarreled with others seriously, but I was not very polite either.
scripts.translation: 我从小接受王室教育。虽然我没有和别人发生过严重的争吵，但我也并不十分礼貌。

scripts.text: People thought that I was timid, but that's because I didn't want to be shun from others.
scripts.translation: 人们觉得我胆小，其实是因为我不想被他人疏远。

scripts.text: Of course, we got an exception... Eigen.
scripts.translation: 当然，我们也有例外...艾根。

scripts.text: Eigen Ahrum can be the exception. He is not polite, but he makes sense from others with exact confirmation.
scripts.translation: 艾根·阿鲁姆是个例外。他虽然不讲究礼节，却总能用确凿的结果让人信服。

scripts.text: I think that is a great ability, and I should learn it. But, it is not only about results, but also a courtesy matter. We should keep something that we have to do.
scripts.translation: 我认为这是一种很棒的能力，我也应该学习。但这不仅仅是结果的问题，更是礼仪的问题。有些规矩我们必须遵守。

scripts.text: For me, the process was more important than the result. Now, I take them as equal virtue. I didn't take results significantly. Ahrum taught me, who used to consider the result as nothing.
scripts.translation: 对我来说，过程比结果更重要。现在，我将两者视为同等的美德。我以前并不看重结果，是阿鲁姆教会了我这一点。

scripts.text: The spirit of nationalism when I become King?
scripts.translation: 我成为国王后的治国理念？

scripts.text: You might believe the power of a king is unlimited, but as one man, it has a limitation.
scripts.translation: 你或许觉得国王无所不能，但终究只是一个人，能力总有极限。

scripts.text: Both normal public and prominent people take charge of the society that gathers that wisdom is easier than doing things on your own.
scripts.translation: 无论是普通百姓还是显贵，汇聚众人的智慧来治理社会，比独自行事要容易得多。

scripts.text: Ahrum will help me to supplement any shortcomings. Not only Ahrum, but all ministers and cabinet members; and the public is my master.
scripts.translation: 阿鲁姆会帮我弥补不足。不光是他，还有各位大臣、内阁成员，乃至百姓，都是我的老师。

scripts.text: It is my fortune that I got many masters beside Ahrum. It is also good for my country.
scripts.translation: 除了阿鲁姆，我还有这么多老师，实在幸运。这对国家也是好事。

scripts.text: II don't have special habits. I am just willing to learn and read books.
scripts.translation: 我没有特别的习惯。我只是喜欢学习和读书。

scripts.text: And I also love to talk with Ahrum. Ahrum is clever enough to generate new ideas that I can follow.
scripts.translation: 我也喜欢和阿鲁姆聊天。他聪明，常有新想法，能给我不少启发。

scripts.text: Well, to tell the truth, going fishing with Ahrum is better. Although, we are too busy to go fishing because of all these kingdom issues.
scripts.translation: 不过，说实话，还是和阿鲁姆一起钓鱼更好。可惜王国事务太多，忙得抽不出时间。

scripts.text: We promised to go fishing after the taking of the throne... Let's see...
scripts.translation: 我们约定在登基后去钓鱼...让我想想...

scripts.text: Once my Eigen Ahrum is chosen to be king, the Richard family will be a second magnate.
scripts.translation: 旦我的艾根·阿鲁姆被选为国王，理查德家族将成为第二大家族。

scripts.text: Hehe, Ahrum is the most favorable and influential candidate already. You would be so amazing were you to fulfill this.
scripts.translation: Hehe，阿鲁姆已经是最有希望、最有影响力的候选人了。要是真能促成此事，您可就了不起了。

scripts.text: Although Ahrum is a strong candidate, the prince of Gaebolg has a high reputation for his virtues too. For sure, it is better to confirm things.
scripts.translation: 虽然阿鲁姆是强有力的候选人，但吉尔伯格的王子也因美德而享有盛誉。当然，最好还是确认一下。

scripts.text: So, are you on the project of Prince Ernst's poisoning?
scripts.translation: 那么，你是参与了对恩斯特王子下毒的计划吗？

scripts.text: Of course. Even an autopsy will not find it. ... You don't have to worry.
scripts.translation: 当然。即使是尸检也查不出来...你不必担心。

scripts.text: Ahrum will be elected, once the termination of prince Ernst happens, and then...
scripts.translation: 一旦恩斯特王子“去世”，阿鲁姆就会被选为国王，然后...

scripts.text: both family will lead this country, huhuhu.
scripts.translation: 到时，这个国家就由我们两家说了算，huhuhu.

scripts.text: You must know what Walter and Gaebolg did. Both families stayed on top of the country.
scripts.translation: 你应该知道沃尔特和吉尔伯格做过什么。这两个家族一直凌驾于国家之上。

scripts.text: The weakest one of the seven families, Gaebolg Family, took power by uniting with Schmidt and Walter.
scripts.translation: 七大家族中最弱的吉尔伯格家族，通过与施密特和沃尔特结盟夺取了权力。

scripts.text: Yes, that's why the union of Walter and Gaebolg is perfect. Moreover, Ahrum and Ernst... It's obviously the second coming of Schmidt and Heinrich.
scripts.translation: 没错，沃尔特和吉尔伯格的联盟可谓天衣无缝。何况阿鲁姆和恩斯特...简直就是当年施密特和海因里希的重演。

scripts.text: That's why the Walter family and the Gaebolg Family can't exist together. Their co-existence will bring destruction as it has done in the past.
scripts.translation: 所以沃尔特家族和吉尔伯格家族无法共存。它们的共存将带来毁灭，就像过去发生过的那样。

scripts.text: Thanks for that. It's good to go. All the people who know of the past will deny to be in league with Ahrum or Ernst.
scripts.translation: 正因为这样，我们才好办事。知道那段往事的人，都不会愿意与阿鲁姆或恩斯特结盟。

scripts.text: Anyway, we got a little bit more time. Keep the secret thoroughly; not to tell anyone.
scripts.translation: 总之，我们多了一点时间。彻底保守秘密；不要告诉任何人。

scripts.text: Yes. For the glory of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation: 是的。为了卢恩·米德加兹的荣耀。
所有的荣耀都归于卢恩·米德加兹...

I told you that I don't want to be king, and I don't have any intention to change my mind!
scripts.translation: 我说过我不想当国王，而且我绝不改变主意！

scripts.text: Brother! I don't know why you are suffering so much! Are you this weak a creature?!
scripts.translation: 哥哥！我不知道你为什么这么痛苦！难道你就这么软弱吗？！

scripts.text: Suffering? Me?..Aaahhh... It looks so...? Yeahh... Yes, it does. Stressful...Huhuhu...Hahaha!!
scripts.translation: 痛苦？我？...Aaahhh... 看起来像吗...？是啊...的确如此。真难受啊...Huhuhu...Hahaha!!

scripts.text: ...Is it only me that gets away... Anyhow, I am a disqualified person ... huhuhu. But, I've made a decision.
scripts.translation: ...难道就我一个人在逃避吗...反正我已经不配了...huhuhu.不过，我已经做出了决定。

scripts.text: - Ahrum casually throws a Bazerald to Ernst.-
scripts.translation: - 阿鲁姆随手将一把华丽短剑扔给了恩斯特。-

scripts.text: Eh?... What's this about?... A Bazerald of Walter family?...Why?
scripts.translation: 呃？...这是怎么回事？...沃尔特家族的华丽短剑？...为什么？

scripts.text: Now this is perfect timing. Even our witness is here! Ern, you remember our promise clearly, right?
scripts.translation: 时机真是完美。连我们的证人都在场！恩斯特，你很清楚我们之间的约定，对吧？
什么？约定？证人？...啊...真...真的是...

scripts.text: Yes, really. Now is the time.
Nonsense! Do you think I can do that to you?!
scripts.translation: 胡说！你以为我会对你下杀手吗？！

scripts.text: Idiot! Being King should be followed by decisive action. I have no chances to be King. Corruption, and living like that, is worse than being killed by you...
scripts.translation: 蠢货！当国王就得杀伐果断。我已经没资格当国王了。与其腐败下去，这样苟活，倒不如死在你手里...

scripts.text: B-but, you can live as you are! As if nothing happened. You are just needed to return to the way you were before. Brother, let me help you. Tell me everything you hide...
scripts.translation: 不...不，你可以像以前一样活下去！就当什么都没发生过。你只需要回到从前的样子。哥哥，让我帮帮你。告诉我你隐藏的一切...

scripts.text: This is so moronic! Can you say that you are kingly?! Are you showing me sympathy now? You should be a man of sense! If not, you are not eligible as a king candidate!
scripts.translation: 这太愚蠢了！你还能说自己有王者风范吗？现在才来同情我？你应该是个有理智的人！如果不是，你就没有资格成为国王候选人！

scripts.text: Talking back and forth is of no use! I cannot help it. If you keep insisting instead of trying to be a man of sense, then such a person should not be a king.
scripts.translation: 这样来回争论毫无意义！我别无选择。如果你坚持己见，而不是像个有理智的人那样行事，那么这样的人就不配当国王。

scripts.text: the best country in the world, by helping each other.
scripts.translation: 恩·米德加兹...建成世界上最好的国家。

scripts.text: No, we shall make it. For Brother and I together, we shall make it.
scripts.translation: 。不，我们一定能做到。我和哥哥一起，一定能做到。

scripts.text: But... If I am to reign, or help you; and if I am corrupted... you kill me... by your hand.
scripts.translation: 但是...如果我掌权，或者辅佐你；如果我变得腐败...你就杀了我...用你的双手。

scripts.text: In the opposite case, I will kill you too, you understand? So don't ever stray, and do not ever forget your determination.
scripts.translation: 反之亦然，我也会杀了你，你明白吗？所以永远不要偏离正道，也永远不要忘记你的决心。

scripts.text: I have been acting for Brother and Kingdom, and I will be the same ever after.

scripts.text: How could you appear so suddenly? Ern and I were in the middle of conversation.
scripts.translation: 。你怎么突然出现？我和恩斯特正在谈话。

scripts.text: What's wrong, brother? We were not talking about anything bad. We were just making our resolution firm.
scripts.translation: 怎么了，哥哥？我们没在说坏事。我们只是在坚定我们的决心。

scripts.text: You came here in good timing.

By all means, be the witness of this agreement. You cannot say no. Because it is a very good thing, in some respects, for your work, isn't it?
scripts.translation: 无论如何，请见证这个约定。你不能拒绝。因为从某些方面来说，这对你的工作很有利，不是吗？

scripts.text: Br...Brother. You are way too suppressive. Our appraiser must have his own position and opinion.
scripts.translation: 哥...哥哥。你太霸道了。我们的评估员必须有自己的立场和意见。

scripts.text: You still have a weak personality. I am not forcing something so difficult on him! Who cares? I take silence as a positive answer! My bid is successful! And our promise is formed too!
scripts.translation: 你这性子，还是太软弱了。我又没强迫他做什么难事！管他呢，沉默就当答应了！提议通过，咱们的约定也就成立了！

scripts.text: Haah...haha... Appraiser, I deeply apologize for offending you. Sorry, but there is no possibility of fulfilling this promise. So, just don't take this situation seriously... You know... When pigs fly... ~
scripts.translation: Haah...haha... 评估员，冒犯了你，实在抱歉。不过，这种约定根本不可能有兑现的一天，所以别太当真...你也知道，除非太阳打西边出来...~

scripts.text: Now, let me return to my room. Keep up the good work, appraiser.
scripts.translation: 现在，让我回房间了。继续努力吧，评估员。

scripts.text: Bbb... Brother?... You... told me you would kill me... You just wanted to be killed by me??... Bbb...brother?...
scripts.translation: 哥...哥哥？...你...你说过要杀我...你只是想让我杀你吗？？...哥...哥哥？...

scripts.text: Huhu... Not at all. I just wanted to kill you... That's it... Good job, Ern... This is legal, self-defense; killing a villain... right?
scripts.translation: Huhu... 才不是。我就是想杀了你...仅此而已...干得好，恩斯特...杀死恶徒，算是合法自卫...对吧？

scripts.text: B..Brother... even now it is not too late! If you go to a medic, you can be restored!
scripts.translation: 哥...哥哥...现在还不晚！如果你去找医务兵，还能救回来！

scripts.text: It's too late... Once your vital organs are stabbed... I wonder how could I stay alive... or even how I could come back to life... I don't need to live.
scripts.translation: 太晚了...一旦要害被刺穿...我还能怎么活下来...或者怎么复活...我不需要活着。
哥...哥哥...你...你怎么能这样？！

scripts.text: Goodbye, my brother... Be King, and change this nation. You... You can make it...guk...
scripts.translation: 再见，我的兄弟...成为国王，改变这个国家。你...你一定能做到...guk...

scripts.text: ...Brother...Brother... Why... Why... How can your face look so satisfied? How...? Brother...
scripts.translation: ...哥哥...哥哥...为什么...为什么...你的表情看起来那么满足？怎么...？哥哥...

scripts.text: Huhu...You don't need to know that. By the way, you kept your promise... You should be king... But if you are lost, and stray, I will come kill you at any time... from hell!!
scripts.translation: Huhu...你不必知道。不过，你遵守了约定...你应该成为国王...可你若迷失方向、误入歧途，我随时会从地狱回来杀你！！

scripts.text: I...I don't know! I don't know what's going on!
scripts.translation: 我...我不知道！我不知道发生了什么！

scripts.text: You don't need to... What you have to know about is that there was a sacrifice from me. To make my death meaningful, you should be a good king. That's my conviction... That's it..guk..! Don't lose my words... gukkuk.
scripts.translation: 你不必知道...你只要记得，我为此做出了牺牲。为了不让我的死白费，你一定要做个好国王。这是我的信念...就是这样...guk..!别忘了我的话...gukkuk.

scripts.text: Ahh... Appraiser, do you know what you have to do? Be mindful of your words. About what you saw, what you heard... You must not tell all of your experience to the inspector.
scripts.translation: 啊...评估员，你知道该怎么做吗？谨言慎行。关于你看到的、听到的...你绝不能把你的经历全部告诉检查员。

scripts.text: Ern killed a villain here who bullied around.. I had no chance... He showed decisive action, and that will deserve him the right to be king...
scripts.translation: 恩斯特在这里杀死了那个横行霸道的恶棍...我没有机会...他展现了果断的行动，这足以让他拥有成为国王的资格...

scripts.text: If you react wrongfully to this incident, my death will be worthless...kuk... Do you understand?
scripts.translation: 要是你没处理好这件事，我就白死了...kuk...明白吗？

scripts.text: ... Okay I will follow your will...
... Okay, I will follow your will. Don't worry...
scripts.translation: ...好的，我会遵从你的意愿。别担心...

scripts.text: Ignorance... is positive... It means... My bid... is successful...
scripts.translation: 沉默...就是同意...这意味着...我的提议...成功了...

scripts.text: Now... I can die... with peace... Thank... you very... much, both... of you.
scripts.translation: 现在...我可以...安息了...谢...谢你们...两个...

scripts.text: Then, perpetually... Bye... Sorry ... now I can't go fishing.
scripts.translation: 那么，永远...再见...抱歉...现在没法去钓鱼了。

scripts.text: Moron. You'll never be a king. All throughout your life... Don't you know it? Such a junk addict!!
scripts.translation: 蠢货。你永远成不了国王。你这一生...难道你不知道吗？真是个毒瘾缠身的废物！！

scripts.text: ...I am not trying to be, but swear words don't make me feel very good. What's wrong with you all of a sudden?
scripts.translation: ...我又没想当国王，可你这么骂人，还是让我很不舒服。你怎么突然这样？

scripts.text: I am just fed up with you. Even a jerk like you is a candidate for king? I feel sick and nauseated about this king succession.
scripts.translation: 我只是受够你了。连你这种混蛋都有资格竞选国王？想到王位继承这件事我就恶心反胃。

scripts.text: Yeah, it's not that wrong. But I am the representative of the Nerious family. I cannot stand for your insults.
scripts.translation: 嗯，你说得也没错。但我代表的是内里乌斯家族。我不能容忍你的侮辱。

scripts.text: Is your family aware of your crazy actions? You are ruining your name, and of your family.
scripts.translation: 你的家人知道你这些疯狂的举动吗？你正在毁掉自己的名声，还有你家族的名声。

scripts.text: ...! Yes... I give a crap. No... My existence too! Kukuku...hahahahaha!
scripts.translation: ...！是啊...我丢尽了脸。不...连我的存在也是如此！Kukuku...hahahahaha!

scripts.text: Yes, you and I are both disqualified! Hahahaha!! The freaking addict reveals the truth! Yes, hahahahahaha!!
scripts.translation: 没错，你和我都不配！Hahahaha!! 瘾君子倒是说出了真相！是啊，hahahahahaha!!

scripts.text: ... Crazy jerk. Beat it. I don't want to talk with you anymore.
scripts.translation: ...疯了的混蛋。滚开。我不想再和你说话了。

scripts.text: Yes, I am going now. Family shame?!! Hahahaha... What is a family!! Kkkkkk!! Very interesting!
scripts.translation: 行，我这就走。家族之耻？！！Hahahaha...家族算什么！！Kkkkkk!!真有意思！

scripts.text: -Ahrum, seems to be out of his mind, as he approaches the door-
scripts.translation: -阿鲁姆似乎已经疯了，他走向门口-

scripts.text: Hey! What did you just say to me? Ahrum?!
scripts.translation: 嘿！你刚才对我说什么？阿鲁姆？！

scripts.text: That's very rude! How could a dirty germ like you talk like that to me!
scripts.translation: 太无礼了！像你这种肮脏的细菌怎么敢那样对我说话！像你

scripts.text: Dirty? Yes, I am. I am dirty. But it is not a problem of mine. Everything is dirty! I cannot stand it anymore!
scripts.translation: 肮脏？是的，我很肮脏。我很脏。但这不是我的问题。一切都是肮脏的！我再也受不了了！

scripts.text: Hm! I can agree with your words, the world is obscene, but you cannot bring me down to that level! I cannot forgive your words! Never, ever!
scripts.translation: 哼！我同意你的话，世界很下流，但你不能把我拉到那个层次！我绝不能原谅你的话！永远，永远都不能！

scripts.text: What if you can't forgive me? What shall you do? That's good. Are you gonna kill me? Will you kill me? Kill me? Haha? You are being called beautiful only when calling yourself!
scripts.translation: 不原谅又怎样？你能做什么？好啊，你要杀了我吗？会杀我吗？杀我？Haha?也只有你自己才会说自己漂亮！

scripts.text: Akk! I cannot stand this! Such low behavior and words ...? You are no prince. I don't want to face you anymore! Get out of here!
scripts.translation: 啊！我受不了了！如此低俗的行为和言语...？你根本不是王子。我不想再面对你了！滚出去！

scripts.text: You don't have enough quality. You don't have belief to eliminate evil. By will, you are rubbish. I don't want to be with rubbish either! Stay in your world forever and never come out of it!
scripts.translation: 你没有足够的素质。你没有铲除邪恶的信念。论意志，你就是个废物。我也不想和废物待在一起！永远待在你自己的世界里，永远别出来！

scripts.text: -Ahrum strides out of the room, grumbling...-
scripts.translation: -阿鲁姆一边嘟囔着一边走出房间-

scripts.text: ...You are so low. I misjudged you. You are not of the few that have an artistic view. I totally saw you the wrong way.
scripts.translation: ...你真是低俗。我看错你了。你并不是少数拥有艺术眼光的人。我完全看走眼了。

scripts.text: Military maniac! Jerk! Do you think power can solve everything? In all situations, do you think people can live peacefully?!
scripts.translation: 军事狂！混蛋！你以为武力能解决一切吗？你真以为不管发生什么，百姓都能安稳过日子？！

scripts.text: By your theory, you are also not eligible for the king's quality!
scripts.translation: 配了。照你的理论，你也不具备国王的素质！

scripts.text: But you are worse than me! King candidate?? You are just a war monger!
scripts.translation: 可你比我更糟！国王候选人？？你就是个战争贩子！

scripts.text: You have come here to offend me? Do you think you can beat me, Eigen Ahrum?!
scripts.translation: 你来这里就是为了侮辱我吗？你以为你能打败我，艾根·阿鲁姆？！

scripts.text: Fight? That's so rubbish. I don't care for it. I just came here to shoot what I want to say to you. I don't even feel like fighting with you. I am leaving!
scripts.translation: 打架？那太无聊了。我不在乎。我只是来这里说我想对你说的话。我甚至不想和你打。我要走了！

scripts.text: Hold on, coward! Are you fleeing now?! Such a coward! Let's finish our battle!
scripts.translation: 站住，胆小鬼！你现在要逃跑吗？！真是胆小鬼！让我们结束这场战斗吧！

scripts.text: Coward.. that's a very nice word. Yes, I am. I am leaving. Ta-tah! You are worse than a bad coward...like me! Bye-bye war monger!
scripts.translation: 胆小鬼...这个词真不错。没错，我就是。我要走了。拜拜！你比我这种差劲的胆小鬼...还要糟糕！再见，战争狂人！

scripts.text: -Ahrum grins with a vague feeling towards an irritated Helmut, and leaves the room.-
scripts.translation: -阿鲁姆意味不明地朝恼怒的赫尔穆特咧嘴一笑，离开了房间。-

scripts.text: You always care about gambling. But, why don't you care about your surrondings first, eh? Young master of Richard?
scripts.translation: 你眼里只有赌博，就不能先看看自己身边吗，理查德家的少爷？

scripts.text: Why are you teasing me, now? At least I feel I have dice with higher numbers than you... You don't think so?
scripts.translation: 你现在为什么取笑我？至少我觉得我的骰子点数比你高...你不这么认为吗？

scripts.text: Posh! You keep talking about dice. Listen. You can feel that I roll lower numbers of dice than you... But you have already failed before the roll of your dice! Do you know that?!
scripts.translation: 哼！你一直谈论骰子。听着。你能感觉到我掷出的骰子点数比你低...但你在掷骰子之前就已经失败了！你知道吗？！

scripts.text: What are you talking about? I can't get you. I've lost to whom? I don't know why you are talking like that.
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？我听不懂。我输给了谁？我不知道你为什么那样说。

scripts.text: You can't know it! So what?! If you know, what can you do? You have too much pride over everything. Do you think you can foster a deeply rotten tree, to become a healthy tree?!
scripts.translation: 你当然不知道！就算知道又怎样？！你能做什么？你对一切都太自信了。你以为能把一棵烂透了的树，养成一棵好树吗？！

scripts.text: If you want to say something, you have to say it clearly. Are you announcing a loss and defeat? Is my luck so dreadful, Eigen Ahrum?
scripts.translation: 如果你想说什么，你就得说清楚。你是在宣布失败和战败吗？我的运气这么糟糕，艾根·阿鲁姆？

scripts.text: Yes, I announce my defeat. But it is not to you. You are a loser like me. Before getting into important business, you are ruined by an environmental element.
scripts.translation: 没错，我认输了，可不是输给你。你跟我一样，都是输家。还没来得及做正事，就已经毁在自己的处境里了。

scripts.text: ...What the hell are you talking about? Environment? I totally don't get you. It is never clear.
scripts.translation: ...你到底在说什么？环境？我完全听不懂。你说的话总是让人摸不着头脑。

scripts.text: You'd better not understand it. If you know this, you will lose your health. Don't care for it... for the rest of your life!!
scripts.translation: 你最好永远别懂。知道了，只会伤身。这一辈子，都别管这事！！

scripts.translation: 彼得，如果你的工作毫无意义，你会怎么做？

scripts.text: ...I don't know what you are talking about, but meaningless things do not exist. I don't think you know about that.
scripts.translation: ...我不知道你在说什么，但不存在毫无意义的事物。我想你并不了解这一点。

scripts.text: Buzzzz. You are wrong. There is a thing that is meaningless itself. Clearly speaking, the action becomes meaningless without knowing its meaning...
scripts.translation: 答错了。有些事本身就是毫无意义的。说白了，不明白行动的意义，做起来就毫无意义...

scripts.text: Are you trying to explain... clearly? It's getting more complicated. What exactly do you want to say? Let me get it directly.
scripts.translation: 你是在试图...解释清楚吗？事情变得越来越复杂了。你到底想说什么？直接告诉我。

scripts.text: ...Whatever I do or do not do, I am just being manipulated by some thing. To make it worse, I hurt others as I am in that some thing only.
scripts.translation: ...不管我做什么，或什么都不做，都只是在受某种东西摆布。更糟的是，光是身在其中，我就已经伤害了别人。

scripts.text: The worst thing is, I feel I just become timid with knowing and understanding the some thing itself..
scripts.translation: 最可悲的是，越看清那东西的真面目，我反而越胆怯...

scripts.text: But it is the same with you. If you really want to express gratitude towards the girl, you should have visited her in person. You couldn't do it, could you?
scripts.translation: 但你也是一样。如果你真的想向那个女孩表达感激，你应该亲自去拜访她。你做不到，对吧？

scripts.text: ...Ahrum, what's wrong with you? You are not the Ahrum I know. What's made you like this?
scripts.translation: ...阿鲁姆，你怎么了？你不再是那个我认识的阿鲁姆了。是什么让你变成这样的？

scripts.text: Hmph..The some thing. Nothing. It's meaningless. Reality, that's all. It was nice talking to you. Bye-bye, and live like what you used to live like, ever after.
scripts.translation: 哼...就是那东西。没什么，也没意义。现实罢了。聊得挺好，再见。你就一辈子照原来的样子活下去吧。

scripts.text: -Ahrum shows a gloomy facial expression and leaves the room.-
scripts.translation: -阿鲁姆露出阴郁的表情，离开了房间。-

scripts.text: Bro, tell me again. You just said something?
scripts.translation: 哥哥，再说一遍。你刚才说了什么？

scripts.text: Ok. Let me tell you. This Rune-Midgarts is rubbish. You and I struggle in the dump of trash, and we are all same with it, even if it cannot be recycled.
scripts.translation: 好，我告诉你。卢恩·米德加兹就是一堆垃圾。你我都在垃圾堆里挣扎，跟那些没法回收的垃圾没什么两样。

scripts.text: Brother, what's wrong? Are you insane?
scripts.translation: 哥哥，你怎么了？你疯了吗？

scripts.text: Insane? I am fully sane....J.m...I am just fed up with this disgusting reality, my lovely brother.
scripts.translation: 疯了？我清醒得很...J.m...我只是受够了这恶心的现实，我亲爱的兄弟。

scripts.text: Reality? What reality? What did you perceive? You are not like as you are. I totally can't help you!
scripts.translation: 现实？什么现实？你察觉到了什么？你变得不像你自己了。我完全帮不了你！

scripts.text: I am as I usually am, Ernst. Just, reality is dirty, and I realized that I am trapped in the crap. I can't get out of here.
scripts.translation: 我和平时一样，恩斯特。只是，现实很肮脏，我意识到自己被困在垃圾里。我出不去了。

scripts.text: Liar! You always told me that you have possibilities in your book! You always behaved proudly!
scripts.translation: 骗人！你以前总说，一切皆有可能！明明一直都是那么意气风发的样子！

scripts.text: It's dirty and not good. That's why we should correct it. We already know about this situation, but why do you act like this!!
scripts.translation: 这很肮脏，也不对劲。所以我们应该纠正它。我们已经知道这种情况了，但你为什么还要这样！！

scripts.text: No. Corruption is mutually agreed, and you brought me here, and because of your presence, I can depend on you!
scripts.translation: 不，关于堕落的事，我们明明有过约定！是你带我走到这里，有你在，我才有依靠！

scripts.text: Meaningless actions cannot be welcomed! Being manipulated by dirt is disgusting. I was ignorant, I felt that I acted by my will, but now I realize I was manipulated!
scripts.translation: 毫无意义的行动，根本不值得称道！被那些肮脏的东西操纵，真恶心。我以前什么都不懂，还以为一切都出自自己的意志，原来只是被人摆布！

scripts.text: King?! What's that for?! That's nothing! Even if we make a new world, nothing is changed!! We are like in a play. A picture is someone's intention... only drawn!! Right?!
scripts.translation: 国王？！当了又怎样？！毫无意义！就算我们创造新世界，也什么都不会改变！！我们不过是在演戏，一切都照着某个人的心意安排好了！！不是吗？！

scripts.text: What are you talking about? I totally can't understand! Are you saying you are not in the status quo? Yes? What the heck are you talking about!
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？我完全不明白！你是想说，自己已经不是原来的自己了吗？是这样吗？你到底在说些什么啊！

scripts.text: Shut up! Without knowing anything, you don't know when you can be killed. You don't get me yet.... ah...! You need to not know this!
scripts.translation: 闭嘴！你什么都不知道，连什么时候会被人杀掉都不知道！你还不明白...啊...！不，你不该知道这些！

scripts.text: Br...Brother, will you keep insisting on this? Our relationship is this short?
scripts.translation: 哥...哥哥，你还要坚持这种说法吗？我们的情谊就这么浅吗？

scripts.text: Shut up! If you are not contented, you can kill me as we promised! You... me... me...!! I don't wanna talk about it any more, I am going back to my room!
scripts.translation: 闭嘴！如果你不满意，就按我们的约定杀了我吧！你...我...我...！！我不想再谈这个了，我要回房间了！

scripts.text: Ah. Hold on a moment Brother! Ahrum!
and leaves the room. He seems to be utterly fatigued.-
scripts.translation: 红着离开了房间。他看起来精疲力竭。-

scripts.text: I cannot have that qualification. I was raised in such a dirty place. I was so ignorant!
scripts.translation: 我不具备那种资格。我是在那样肮脏的地方长大的。我太无知了！

scripts.text: What's the capacity of a king? And what is clean politics...? Ahhhhhhhhhhh!!
scripts.translation: 究竟什么是国王的器量？什么才是清明的政治...？Ahhhhhhhhhhh!!

scripts.text: Birth?... King's family? ...What's all that about?
scripts.translation: 的...出身？...王室？...这些到底算什么？

scripts.text: To brother Ernst, from my family. It's sin. And I am a part of the sin. As a part of the family. Family's sin. Equal to my sin.
scripts.translation: 我的家族，竟然要对恩斯特做那种事。那是罪孽，而我也是其中一部分。身为家族的一员，家族的罪，就是我的罪。

scripts.text: I cannot... cover it anymore... Ern... I hope even you...
scripts.translation: 我再也...没法包庇了...恩斯特...至少你要...

scripts.text: In the end, I am just being used... I make the most of my exertions and become the lead. That's all a part of the scenario...
scripts.translation: 到头来，我只是被利用罢了...我竭尽全力，成为领袖。那不过是剧本的一部分...

scripts.text: I cannot accept it. Never. Never!
My ancestor ^FF0000Schmidt^000000... What shall you do with this situation? No...were you just used like me... by others?
scripts.translation: 我的祖先施密特...面对这种局面，你会怎么做？不...难道你也是像我一样...被他人利用了吗？ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: No, it's no good... No... In this phase, I will be the king. I shouldn't be the king... Ern... You should not forget the meaning of a real king.
scripts.translation: 不，这样不行...不行...再这样下去，我就会当上国王。我不能当国王...恩斯特...你可别忘了，真正的国王意味着什么。

scripts.text: For the real king's appearance... I am going tonight.... to darkness for you. ...Ahhhhhhhh!!!
scripts.translation: 为了让真正的国王出现...今晚，我要为你...走入黑暗。...Ahhhhhhhh!!!

scripts.text: You can go to the room where princes gather, through the hidden door. For security reasons, it is totally guarded and hidden.
scripts.translation: 你可以通过隐藏的门前往王子们聚集的房间。出于安全考虑，那里被严密守卫并隐藏起来。

scripts.text: I just came here to rest. For location information, you can ask it of others.
scripts.translation: 我只是来这里休息的。关于位置信息，你可以去问别人。

scripts.text: Who is going to have the throne instead of him?
What thoughts did he have, and how did he decide to become King in this room?
scripts.translation: 他当时在想什么，又是如何决定在这个房间里成为国王的？

scripts.text: pulled him back to an irreparable place?
scripts.translation: ...将他推向了无法挽回的地步？

scripts.text: I can't ask him anymore, and there are no clues left. Just what's left is...
scripts.translation: 我无法再问他了，也没有留下任何线索。剩下的只有...

scripts.text: ~~If you react wrongfully to this incident, my death will be worthless...kuk... Do you understand?~~
scripts.translation: ~~要是你没处理好这件事，我就白死了...kuk...明白吗？~~

scripts.text: Taking the burden that he left... all throughout my life.
scripts.translation: 承担他留下的重担...直到我生命的尽头。
